---
title: "About"
---

The [`djehuty`](https://github.com/4TUResearchData/djehuty) community brings together users, contributors, developers, research data professionals, and everyone interested in the future of the `djehuty` platform.

Our goal is to create an open space for collaboration, knowledge sharing, and discussion around `djehuty`'s development and use. Through community meetings, discussions, proposals, and shared experiences, we work together to improve the platform and support the research data community.

## How we work together

- **Meet.** Once a month we hold an open online [Community Hour](community-hour/index.qmd) to discuss recent developments, upcoming work, and your topics. Dates are in the [calendar](calendar/index.qmd).
- **Discuss.** Ideas, questions and proposals live in the [GitHub discussions](https://github.com/4TUResearchData/djehuty/discussions).
- **Contribute.** Whether you report an issue, improve documentation, or write code, there is a place for you. See [ways to contribute](contribute.qmd).

## Code of Conduct

In our communication we adhere to the [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/4TUResearchData/djehuty?tab=coc-ov-file).
